story.title: The Silence Debt
story.logline: A man discovers that every spoken word in his city has a literal physical weight that must be carried.
story.theme: The hidden cost of idle speech.
story.twist: The heavy stones he has been hauling for years are not his own words, but the silent thoughts of everyone who judged him.
story.ending: Will you speak your mind, or let the invisible mountain crush your final breath?

scenes.narration: My tongue felt heavy because every single word you speak turns into solid stone inside your pocket.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close up of 25-year-old Leo with messy brown hair and a dark hoodie, in a gray concrete room.

scenes.narration: Leo stumbled down the narrow alley, clutching his canvas jacket as jagged boulders strained the worn seams.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo with messy brown hair and a dark hoodie, walking through a gloomy gray city alley.

scenes.narration: He had argued too much at work today, leaving his coat pockets crammed with jagged, painful conversation fragments.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo with messy brown hair and a dark hoodie, pulling a glowing gray stone from his jacket pocket.

scenes.narration: Most people learned to whisper early, trading meaningful glances instead of risking the crushing weight of gossip.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo with messy brown hair and a dark hoodie, watching silent commuters pass by in a gray city.

scenes.narration: Leo reached his apartment door, desperate to drop his heavy burden and finally enjoy a moment of absolute quiet.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo with messy brown hair and a dark hoodie, fumbling with keys outside a metal apartment door.

scenes.narration: Inside, he emptied his pockets onto the steel scale, watching the jagged gray rocks pile up alarmingly high.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo with messy brown hair and a dark hoodie, dumping glowing stones onto a digital scale indoors.

scenes.narration: The scale blinked red, showing ten kilograms. But Leo had stayed completely silent during his entire shift today.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo with messy brown hair and a dark hoodie, staring in shock at a glowing red digital scale.
scenes.camera: Close up on scale, rack focus to Leo's face

scenes.narration: He picked up a heavy stone and smashed it open, expecting to find his own spoken complaints inside.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo with messy brown hair and a dark hoodie, hammering a glowing gray stone on a concrete floor.

scenes.narration: Instead, tiny whispered insults from his neighbors spilled out, proving he had been carrying everyone else's judgment.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo with messy brown hair and a dark hoodie, watching glowing letters float out of a broken stone.

scenes.narration: If our unspoken thoughts weigh us down this much, whose voice is really breaking your back right now?
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo with messy brown hair and a dark hoodie, looking directly into the camera with glowing stones around him.
scenes.camera: Direct eye contact, slow push in

caption.hook: Words have weight. His are crushing.
caption.title: The Silence Debt
caption.caption:
In a city where every spoken word turns to stone, he’s spent a lifetime hauling the heaviest loads. But the cruelest truth isn't what he said—it's what they thought.

Who are you carrying today?
